R61 — PS4 EA-MP3 (SNS codec `0x0b`, NHL 15–17 speech; sfx everywhere) block structure and preview feasibility. Read-only over the banks;
the only writes are temporary MP3 / WAV files in the session scratchpad (removed unless --keep).

Measured per sampled record: `.sbr` DSET record (.SID, .OFF, .DUR) → `.sbs` SNS block stream (`0x48` SNR header, `0x44` data blocks with
u24 size | u32 samples-in-block | payload, `0x45` end) → the payload's leading bytes before the first MPEG sync, the MPEG-1 Layer III
header found there (bitrate / rate / channel mode), and then whether the payload is a tiling sequence of MPEG frames (the naive
"concatenate and hand to ffmpeg" hypothesis) or an EA granule container with the subsequent frame headers removed. Also counts the
samples-in-block quantum and runs the naive ffmpeg decode per vector so the refusal is measured, not assumed.
Usage: python r61_ea_mp3_block_structure.py <out.json> [--titles nhl15,nhl16,nhl17] [--per-title 6] [--keep]
